package repository

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

// TeacherOnboardingSemanticInterpreter is the only Teacher port for semantic
// onboarding interpretation. Implementations must use AI Prompt's confidential
// endpoint; Teacher orchestration and Student mutation remain outside this port.
type TeacherOnboardingSemanticInterpreter interface {
	InterpretOnboardingSemantic(ctx context.Context, input domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution, error)
	ReplayOnboardingSemantic(ctx context.Context, aiExecutionID string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution, error)
}
